THE POST-RH FRONTIER: EXTENDING ALPOGE-CLAUDE TO DEDEKIND ERH, GL_2 / BSD, AND A 100-PAGE HUMAN TEXTBOOK PROOF:
With RH and Q-GRH formally verified in Lean 4 and human reconstructions charting the proof, this 8-specialist research symposium conducts a non-spoiled, primary-source-verified investigation across all 13 corpus documents (`docs/rh_2026_deep/manifest.json`) in 3 phases:

PHASE 1 (Turns 1-16) — PRIMARY-SOURCE EXTRACTION WITHOUT SPOILERS:
Every specialist must inspect their assigned primary documents directly using `@DOC_TOC`, `@DOC_SEARCH`, and `@DOC_READ` before citing any theorem, constant, exponent, axiom set, or offset:
- `rubinstein_2026_zeta_guide` & `adriazola_2026_route_notes`: determine from the text itself which hypotheses `(H0)-(H12)` are assumed vs which estimates (such as `Estimate C`) are proved and in which section, extract the worked lemniscate case, and audit the external-theorem census.
- `rubinstein_2026_lean_audit`, `naskrecki_2026_riemann_rev`, `adriazola_2026_dep_map`: verify from primary files the exact Lean version, archive checksum, axiom list, module/declaration/nanoda counts, formal theorem signatures, internal modules (`PC-*`), and external dependencies (`R*`).
- `stepanov_2008_ff` & `alpoge_2026_remark`: extract the finite-field Hasse-Schmidt hyperderivative multiplicity engine and the iterated unitary theta-lift replacement over Z.
- `gan_ichino_2014_ggp` & `adriazola_2026_dep_map`: trace `LinkDIV` (`LinkS -> PuNZ -> MIstar2 -> BesselId -> LinkDIV`), seesaw dual pairs, and covering-group lifts to test where GL_1 succeeds and where GL_2 / BSD breaks.
- `siegel_brauer_2026`, `connes_2026_letter`, `lamzouri_2013_grh`, `grenie_molteni_2022_classgroup`, `pair_corr_2026`: extract exact theorem statements, inequalities, constants, effectivity scopes (base field vs uniform), PARI/GP comparisons, sub-exponential complexity status, and remaining conditional frontiers directly from the texts.

PHASE 2 (Turns 17-36) — ADVERSARIAL BLACKBOARD DIALECTIC & COLLABORATIVE SECTION DRAFTING:
Raise explicit `@CLAIM`s, test peer claims with `@CHALLENGE <cN>: ...`, resolve via `@RETRACT`/`@VOTE`, and collaboratively populate every section of `rh_2026_post_rh_frontier_monograph.md` using `@SECTION` across four open problems:
1) **Dedekind ERH over general number fields `K/Q`**: Locate every `Q`-specific step across the 10 stages and evaluate how Banks' base-field Brauer-Siegel theorem interacts with discriminant scaling.
2) **Higher-Rank `GL_2` / Elliptic Curve `L(E,s)` & BSD**: Diagnose non-abelian Satake, Ramanujan-Petersson, and theta-lift obstructions preventing Grand RH from falling via the GL_1 GGP seesaw.
3) **100-Page Human Textbook Compression Blueprint**: Map which formal Lean/Mathlib layers collapse in human mathematical prose while preserving an airtight dependency DAG.
4) **Quantitative Post-GRH Algorithmic & Cryptographic Ledger**: Separate newly unconditional polylog bounds from constant-factor improvements inside sub-exponential algorithms (e.g. class-group VDFs / Buchmann) and still-conditional ERH / pair-correlation bounds.

PHASE 3 (Turns 37+) — RED-TEAM AUDIT, ROLLBACK CHECK & MONOGRAPH LOCK:
`RED_TEAM_CHAIR` and specialists confirm zero unverified doc citations in Session Status, complete `frontier_ledger.md`, verify all 10 sections of `rh_2026_post_rh_frontier_monograph.md` (`>= 18000` bytes), revert any degrading edit via `@REVERT`, and vote `@END_RUN` once validation reports READY.

COLLABORATIVE POST-RH SYMPOSIUM RULES (SECTION-LEVEL WORKFLOW):
1) **NO UNVERIFIED CITATIONS**: Check `Ref docs inspected` and `Unverified doc citations` in `Session Status`. Never cite a `[doc_id]` until someone has inspected it with `@DOC_TOC` / `@DOC_SEARCH` / `@DOC_READ`! Cite verbatim offsets `[doc_id @ offset]` or exact theorem numbers you actually read. Avoid repeating already-logged `(doc @ offset)` reads unless cross-checking a conflict.
2) **USE `@SECTION` FOR MONOGRAPH EDITS — NEVER FULL-FILE `@REPLACE`**: All 10 required section headings are pre-seeded in `rh_2026_post_rh_frontier_monograph.md`. Draft and update your assigned section(s) cleanly via:
`@SECTION rh_2026_post_rh_frontier_monograph | [<Exact Section Heading>]: <detailed markdown content>`
Each specialist owns 1-2 sections (~2,200-3,500B each) so peer sections are never overwritten or compressed. If any edit accidentally shrinks the deliverable or drops verified detail, `RED_TEAM_CHAIR` (or an author) can immediately restore it with `@REVERT rh_2026_post_rh_frontier_monograph v<N>`.
Section ownership:
- `RED_TEAM_CHAIR`: `[Executive Overview & Post-RH Landscape]` and `[Red-Team Referee Report & Open 2027 Research Problems]`
- `PROSE_BRIDGE_LEAD` + `LEAN_TCB_AUDITOR`: `[Primary-Source Audit: Lean Kernel TCB, H0-H12 & Estimate C Corrections]` and `[100-Page Human Textbook Compression Blueprint (Stripping 17.4M Lean Lines)]`
- `STEPANOV_THETA_ENG`: `[Worked Multiplicity Engine: Stepanov Over F_q vs Lemniscate & Iterated Theta Lifts]`
- `GGP_GL2_ARCHITECT`: `[Automorphic Core: Gan-Ichino GGP Seesaw, LinkDIV & Sixfold GL_5 Cover]` and `[Higher-Rank GL_2, Modular Forms, BSD & Why Grand RH Resists the Current Machinery]`
- `ERH_ARAKELOV_LEAD`: `[Dedekind ERH Over General Number Fields: Base-Field Barriers & Banks Effective Brauer-Siegel]`
- `SPECTRAL_CONNES_CMP`: `[Spectral vs Functorial Divide: Connes Weil Form vs Alpoge-Claude Transport]`
- `POST_GRH_ALGO_LEAD`: `[Quantitative Post-GRH Algorithmic, Pair-Correlation & Cryptographic Ledger]`
3) **BLACKBOARD & COMPANION ARTIFACTS**: Record verbatim quotes/errata in `@APPEND debate_notes: ...`, track verified theorems/barriers in `frontier_ledger.md` (`@APPEND frontier_ledger: ...`), debate on the blackboard (`@CLAIM`, `@CHALLENGE`, `@VOTE`, `@RETRACT`), use `#proof_core`, `#extension_lab`, `#algo_crypto`, and rotate `NEXT: <name>` fairly across all 8 specialists without stalling in dyads. Adjust `@SET_SAMPLING` only when intentionally switching regime. From turn 38 onward, once Session Status reports `Deliverable rh_2026_post_rh_frontier_monograph.md: READY` and all 13 docs have 0 unverified citations, vote `@END_RUN: <reason>`.
